# Godot 4 Workspace Rules
- You have access to the complete official Godot Documentation in this workspace under the "godot-docs" folder.
- Before generating code or answering architectural questions, always reference the relevant markdown/RST files in the "godot-docs" folder to verify GDScript 2.0 syntax.
- Prioritize files under `godot-docs/classes/` for API methods and signatures.
- Reference tutorials under `godot-docs/tutorials/` for guidance on architecture, development patterns, and best practices on usage of framework classes.
